responsibility: Contains GCC’s main DWARF debug-information producer, covering both general DWARF debug sections and large parts of frame/unwind data integration. This file owns the persistent state for DWARF section construction, DIE graphs, abbreviation tables, string pools, line tables, ranges, public name/type tables, location lists, FDE/CIE-related bookkeeping, and emission sequencing for compilation units and split DWARF forms; it also coordinates with debug hooks and the DWARF-based CTF/BTF path, and provides the global reset routine that clears dwarf2out state so the compiler can be rerun in-process.
same_name_distinction: Implements the full DWARF producer and owns the underlying DIE/section state that other same-stem files rely on; in particular, dwarf2ctf.cc consumes the DWARF DIEs and hooks exported from this file rather than generating general DWARF sections itself.
